steamify.options.title: Steerer Settings
steamify.haptic.mining.tooltip: A faint tick at each crack stage while breaking a block
steamify.haptic.fishing.tooltip: A buzz the moment a fish takes the bait
steamify.haptic.explosion.tooltip: Rumble from nearby blasts, stronger the closer they are
steamify.haptic.thunder.tooltip: Rumble when lightning strikes, stronger the closer it is
steamify.haptic.bow.tooltip: Ticks that quicken as a bow draws and a click at full draw. Also clicks when a crossbow loads or a threetine is ready
steamify.haptic.shield.tooltip: A thud when your shield stops a hit
steamify.haptic.heartbeat.tooltip: A heartbeat at 3 hearts and below, faster the lower you go
steamify.haptic.trigger.tooltip: Pulling a trigger past its click point
steamify.haptic.rightPad.tooltip: Light ticks while your thumb moves on the right trackpad
steamify.haptic.hotbar.tooltip: A tick each time the left trackpad picks a new hotbar slot
steamify.haptic.footsteps.tooltip: Each step on the ground, alternating left and right
steamify.haptic.damage.tooltip: Taking harm, harder the bigger the hit
steamify.haptic.landing.tooltip: Hitting the ground after a fall, stronger the further you fell
steamify.haptic.flight.tooltip: Low wind rumble while gliding or flying, pulsing faster the faster you go
steamify.haptic.falling.tooltip: Sharp rattle while falling, faster the faster you fall
steamify.calibrate.title: True Up Whirlgauge
steamify.calibrate.hint: Put the steerer down on a flat surface and don't touch it
steamify.calibrate.waiting: Waiting for the steerer to be still...
steamify.calibrate.noGyro: No steerer with a whirlgauge linked
steamify.calibrate.button.tooltip: Measures the whirlgauge's resting drift with the steerer lying still. Redo it if aiming drifts or slow turns feel off
steamify.calibrate.prompt.title: True up your whirlgauge?
steamify.calibrate.prompt: Whirlgauge aiming feels best once the steerer has been trued. It takes a few seconds with the steerer lying on a flat surface.
steamify.options.sets.tooltip: Extra layers of steerer binds, switched on by a button, a grip, a stick touch or a stick pushed to its edge
steamify.sets.title: Deed Sets
steamify.sets.add.tooltip: A layer of binds on top of the everyday ones. It only changes the binds you set in it
steamify.sets.name: Name
steamify.sets.trigger.tooltip: Click, then press the button or together-push, touch a grip or stick, or push a stick to its edge. Already holding a grip? Let go and touch it again. Hold B for a other to cancel. Right-click (or LT) to pick from a list
steamify.sets.enter.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches on
steamify.sets.enter.title: %s: On Go in
steamify.sets.exit.tooltip: Pressed once when the set switches off
steamify.sets.exit.title: %s: On Go out
steamify.sets.hold.tooltip: Held down the whole time the set is on, and let go when it switches off. E.g. a zoom key, on a set triggered by R5
steamify.sets.hold.title: %s: Hold While On
steamify.sets.mode.tooltip: Hold: on while the trigger is held. Toggle: each press switches it. While Released: on while the trigger is NOT held, e.g. letting go of a grip
steamify.sets.where.tooltip: In Bills: the set's binds work on bill screens like the inventory, over the everyday bill controls on the buttons they use. Handy for a mod's inventory keys
steamify.sets.places.tooltip: Click while in a oneplayer world or on a host to add it, again to take away it. From the title sheet: clear. With worlds set, the set is only on there. With no trigger or things, it's always on there
steamify.sets.gyro.tooltip: Whirlgauge while this set is on. Unchanged leaves it to the sets below, normally on while the right pad is touched
steamify.battery.low.title: Steerer lifestore low
steamify.sets.items.tooltip: Click while holding an thing to add it, again to take away it. With an empty hand: clear. With things set, the set is only on while you hold one of them (and its button trigger, if it has one, is awake)
steamify.sets.tunes.tooltip: Stick, pad and whirlgauge speed, deadzone, Steady Aim and aim help while this set is on
steamify.sets.tunes.title: %s: Keenness
steamify.sets.tunes.slider.tooltip: All the way left: unchanged, the everyday Steerer Settings value applies
steamify.sets.binds.tooltip: Controls sheet for this set. Grey binds come from the everyday layout. Escape to unbind in this set, Backspace to go back to the everyday bind
steamify.sets.editing: Editing deed set: %s  (Escape to unbind, Backspace to use the everyday bind)
steamify.option.hotbar.strip.tooltip: OFF: a 3x3 grid in the middle of the sheet, slots 1-3 on the top row. ON: the pad's width maps to the hotbar, left edge slot 1, right edge slot 9
steamify.option.hotbar.gridSpot.tooltip: Middle: the grid pops up while the left pad is touched. A corner: the grid stays there in place of the everyday hotbar. Not used with Strip Layout
steamify.option.hud.showBinds.tooltip: Shows button hints in the bottom starboard corner fer what ye can do right now, like Bedrock Edition
steamify.debug.title: Debug Shortcuts
steamify.option.look.stickSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick turns the eye
steamify.option.look.padSpeed.tooltip: How far the eye turns per swipe on the right trackpad
steamify.option.look.gyro.tooltip: Eye turning per steerer turning. 1.0x turns the eye just as far as you turn the steerer
steamify.option.look.gyroAccel.tooltip: More sensitivity fer quick turns. At 100%, whippin' the controller 'round turns yer spyglass up to twice as far, while slow movements keep normal sensitivity fer a true aim
steamify.option.look.stickDeadzone.toolt: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the eye or player drifts on its own
steamify.option.menu.cursorSpeed.tooltip: How fast the right stick and trackpad move the pointer in bills
steamify.option.look.invertY.tooltip: Flips up and down for stick, trackpad and whirlgauge eye control
steamify.option.gyro.steadyAim.tooltip: Lowers whirlgauge keenness while drawing a bow, charging a crossbow, readying a threetine, using a spyglass or holding a loaded crossbow
How much Steady Aim lowers whirlgauge keenness
steamify.option.aim.assist.tooltip: Slows turning while your crosshair is on a mob in reach and gently pulls toward it while you steer. Steerer only, never affects the mouse
steamify.option.aim.assistStrength.toolt: How strongly aim help slows and pulls
steamify.option.aim.assistSingleplayerOn: Turns aim help off on hosts and LAN worlds
steamify.onboard.title: Steamify Setup
steamify.onboard.page1: Show yer buttons upon the screen?
steamify.onboard.page2: This can be changed later in settings
steamify.onboard.page3: Whirlgauge aiming feels best once the steerer has been trued. It takes a few seconds with the steerer lying on a flat surface.
steamify.onboard.gyro.none: This steerer has no whirlgauge, so there's nothing to true up
steamify.option.haptics.master.tooltip: Scales every feel-shake effect at once. The individual sliders below set each effect relative to this
steamify.onboard.page4: Try the right stick, the right trackpad, and the whirlgauge while your thumb rests on the trackpad
steamify.onboard.look.noPads: Try the right stick, an' the gyro if yer controller has one
steamify.onboard.page5: Which layouts should the on-sheet keyboard switch between?
steamify.bind.tooltip: Click, then press a button or together-push, push a stick to its edge or swipe a trackpad. Right-click (or LT) to pick long press, twofold press and other press types
steamify.bind.title: %s: Steerer Binds
steamify.bind.combo.tooltip: Click, then press the new button or together-push, push a stick to its edge or swipe a trackpad. Right-click (or LT) to pick from a list. Escape to take away this bind
steamify.gesture.regular.tooltip: On for as long as you hold the buttons
steamify.gesture.short.tooltip: Taps when you let go before the long press time. Pair it with a Long Press on the same buttons to give them two deeds
steamify.gesture.long.tooltip: Turns on once you've held for the long press time, and stays on until you let go
steamify.gesture.double.tooltip: Turns on with a quick other press and stays on while you hold it. A Short Press on the same buttons waits out the twofold press time first
steamify.gesture.start.tooltip: Taps the moment you press, even when the same buttons also have a long or twofold press
steamify.gesture.release.tooltip: Taps when you let go, however long you held
steamify.option.binds.longPress.tooltip: How long to hold for a Long Press. Letting go sooner counts as a Short Press
steamify.option.binds.doublePress.toolti: How soon the other press of a Twofold Press has to come
steamify.option.binds.stickEdge.tooltip: How far a stick has to be pushed for its edge inputs (L Stick Up, L Stick Edge...), from the middle (0%%) to all the way (100%%)
steamify.option.binds.padEdge.tooltip: How far from the middle your finger has to be for a trackpad's edge inputs (L Pad Up, L Pad Edge...)
steamify.option.binds.swipeStep.tooltip: How far your finger travels per press of a swipe input (L Pad Swipe Up...), in hundredth of the pad's width. Lower scrolls faster
steamify.steam.toast.body: May cause twofold inputs. Close Steam.
steamify.steam.warning: Steam is running: its steerer layout may twofold your inputs
steamify.steam.warning.fix: Close Steam while playing with Steamify
steamify.picker.hint: Pick one, or several to hold together
steamify.profiles.title: Likenesses
steamify.profiles.button.tooltip: Whole setups to switch between with one click: binds, deed sets and these settings. Each steerer remembers the likeness you last used with it and switches back to it when it links. Whirlgauge truing is shared by all of them
steamify.profiles.add.tooltip: Adds a copy of the current likeness to the list. Click it to switch to it
steamify.option.look.padFriction.tooltip: How quickly a flick on the right trackpad spins down. Higher stops sooner
steamify.share.invalid: The cutboard doesn't hold anything copied from Steamify
steamify.profiles.copy.tooltip: Copies this likeness to the cutboard as one line of text to share. Whirlgauge truing isn't included, but world names and host addresses in its deed sets are
steamify.profiles.paste.tooltip: Adds a likeness from text copied with Copy, and switches to it
steamify.sets.copy.tooltip: Copies this set to the cutboard as one line of text to share
steamify.sets.paste.tooltip: Adds a set from text copied with Copy Set
steamify.profiles.name.tooltip: Name of the awake likeness (the highlighted one)
steamify.profiles.lock.tooltip: Keeps the steerer you're using tied to this likeness. Switching likenesses still works, but the steerer comes back to this one the next time you pick it up
steamify.profiles.controllers.tooltip: Choose which likeness each steerer uses, without picking it up
steamify.controllers.title: Steerers
steamify.controllers.none: No steerers yet. One shows up here once it links up
steamify.controllers.forget.tooltip: Takes this steerer off the list. It gets a new likeness the next time it links up
steamify.option.gyro.playerSpace.tooltip: ON: turning left and right follows the skyline however you hold the steerer, so twisting or tipping it both turn. OFF: only turning the steerer about its own upright axle turns
